cap: In azoospermia, start with the ejaculate. Low volume, acidic pH and no fructose mean seminal vesicle fluid is missing, so look for CBAVD with CFTR mutations or ejaculatory duct obstruction. With normal volume, testis size and FSH separate obstructive disease from testicular failure and from hypogonadotropic disease. Sperm in post-ejaculatory urine mean retrograde ejaculation.
teach: Spermatogenesis takes about 74 days plus 10 to 14 days of epididymal transit, so a semen analysis reflects events about 3 months earlier and any treatment needs 3 months before the repeat. CBAVD needs CFTR testing of both partners.
